summary.text: Travis Johnson is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 21, which covers Catahoula, Concordia, East Carroll, Franklin, Madison and Tensas parishes, and was first elected in 2019. His official House page lists him as Vice Chair of the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Johnson's occupation as senior business development consultant.
It lists his education as a B.S. in political science and economics from Louisiana Tech University and a master's degree in public administration from Belhaven University.

He is also listed as a member of the Natural Resources and Environment and Ways and Means committees and of the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
